schema.title: Role Matrix Lab Master
schema.description: Instance data for the role-matrix-lab authorization fixture. Three of the properties carry x-roles so that field-level pruning is observable from the data function alone: an unguarded field, an allowlist field and a deny-bearing field.

caseRef.description: Unguarded. Every caller that passes the queryRoles gate sees this, so its presence proves the read succeeded and only the guarded fields were pruned.

decisionNote.description: Deny-bearing set. approver and auditor are allowed; maker is explicitly denied. DENY wins, so a caller holding BOTH maker and approver still loses this field.

auditTrail.description: Allowlist set with a single ALLOW: only the auditor sees it. Everyone else — including the approver who may decide the case — is pruned.

intakeEntries.description: onEntry counter for the intake state. Unguarded: lifecycle assertions must not depend on the caller's roles.

reviewEntries.description: onEntry counter for the review state.

noteMarks.description: Increment count of the record-note $self shared transition.

decision.description: The submitted decision, echoed from the approve/reject transition payload.

maskedForAll.description: x-masking without roles: every caller sees it masked (keepLast 4). Proves the transform runs for the most privileged reader too.

maskedExceptAuditor.description: x-masking with a deny-only exemption list: the auditor sees it clear, every other caller (including one with no roles or a misspelled role) sees it masked.

replacedNote.description: x-masking replace: every caller sees the fixed placeholder.

mirroredMasked.description: Unguarded copy of maskedExceptAuditor written by the mirror-self transition's GetInstanceData task (system read).

mirroredAuditTrail.description: Unguarded copy of auditTrail written by the mirror-self transition's GetInstanceData task (system read).

hashedCustomerNo.description: x-encryption hash with a deny-only exemption: the auditor sees it clear, every other caller sees the salted SHA-256 digest (salt = host SchemaEncryption:HashSalt).

customer.description: Nested exposure fixture. The object itself is unguarded; its children carry every rule shape so pruning and masking are observed below the root.

tckn.description: Nested x-masking with a deny-only exemption for the auditor.

segment.description: Nested x-roles ALLOW list: approver and auditor only.

contact.description: Nested x-roles DENY-only subtree: everyone except the maker (and except a role-less caller, who cannot clear a role-bound deny). Its children carry their own rules, which never run for a caller the parent hides.

accounts.description: Array of objects guarded as a whole by an ALLOW list (approver, auditor). Items keep their shape and number types for the callers who see it.

riskScore.description: Non-string field guarded by an ALLOW list (auditor only).

ownerNote.description: Predefined grant: only the caller whose act_sub started the instance sees it.

tags.description: Unguarded array of strings: must come back verbatim and in order.

mirroredPhone.description: Unguarded copy of customer.contact.phone written by mirror-self's GetInstanceData task (system read).

vault.description: x-encryption encrypt lab: stored as AES-256-GCM tokens in InstancesData, plaintext in the engine; the auditor reads clear, everyone else the stored token.

mirroredVaultEmail.description: System-read copy of vault.email (trigger tasks read plaintext).

scriptSawVaultEmail.description: vault.email as the engine's script context sees it (plaintext).
